name: KU Engineering Summer Camp
org: University of Kansas School of Engineering
what_you_do: A week-long overnight camp at the KU School of Engineering. Campers use engineering facilities and meet faculty. They live on campus in a residence hall.
grades: Rising 9th and 10th graders, or rising 11th and 12th graders
who_can_apply: Rising 9th and 10th graders go to the July 11 to 16, 2027 camp. Rising 11th and 12th graders go to the July 18 to 23, 2027 camp. Everyone stays overnight in the residence hall, even if they live nearby.
pay_detail: Cost not stated on the program page
duration: One week each (two camps in July 2027)
deadline_text: Registration opens in February 2027 (exact day not stated). The 2027 theme will be announced soon.
how_to_apply: Register online when registration opens in February. Send questions to the camp email. It is on the page.
notes: The page says all students must stay overnight. Check the page for cost and the theme once posted.
